record.question:
Which of the following statements is NOT CORRECT about the Viksit Bharat-Guarantee for Rozgar
    and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) (VB-G RAM G) Act, 2025:
options: It replaces MGNREGA with a new statutory framework aligned with Viksit Bharat 2047.
The Act guarantees 135 days of wage employment per rural household in each financial year.
Links wage employment with durable rural infrastructure across 4 priority areas.
